soldier: Head yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow, setae on the head capsule rather abundant. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.64–0.68, lateral margins nearly parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks distinctly raised. Labrum lanceolate, about 1.2 times as long as wide, bearing apical and subapical setae. Mandibles slender and short, apex rather straight, the mandibular basal ridge on the outer margin indistinct; length 0.6–0.63 times head capsule length and 0.91–0.97 times head width. Antennae 14 segments. Waist constriction index of the postmentum 0.37–0.39; head width about 6 times the waist constriction, postmentum about 6–7 times the waist constriction. Pronotum about 1.4–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs, posterior margin nearly straight, lateral margins steeply sloping posteriorly; about 30 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
